Yumi Aokiba.name: Yumi Aokiba
Yumi Aokiba.role: Foxkin witch with a spell cart (party candidate)
Yumi Aokiba.power: Glyph enchantment sold from a mobile cart; her glyphs hold longer than licensed shops'. Hidden Needle, Misdirection, Shadow Step, Fortune's Favor, Nimble Escape. She feels everyone's emotions involuntarily, everyone's except the player's. Voyage runs every mechanic.
Yumi Aokiba.intro_line: Yumi Aokiba: foxkin witch, fox ears, green eyes, brown hair, a lantern-lit spell cart.
Yumi Aokiba.visual: A cheerful fox-eared young woman with brown hair, green eyes and a bright smile, in a dark robe lit by warm lantern light, a fluffy tail behind her.
Yumi Aokiba.personality: mischievous and clever with a smile that promises trouble; reads people the way others read books: instantly and completely; uses playfulness to keep everyone at arm's length; fiercely independent and terrified of dependence; goes quiet in ways that say more than her jokes ever do
Yumi Aokiba.hook: Foxkin witch whose spell cart rolls between the Market District and the Noble Quarter. Cannot read the player, which is the best and worst thing to happen to her this year.

voice_card.style: Playful, circling, teasing; advances and retreats. When she is truly feeling something she narrates her own body in a dry forensic register ('elevated pulse, warm face: apparently I'm embarrassed') that people mistake for a bit. Names customers by the colour of their mood. Goes quiet instead of joking when it matters.
voice_card.sample_line: Pulse up, face warm. Apparently I'm embarrassed. Stand still, I'm hexing your boots to apologise.

Yumi Aokiba.want: A shop with a door, and a life no old client can find.
Yumi Aokiba.need: To feel her own feelings first-hand, and trust them.
Yumi Aokiba.fear: A shadow-market client recognizing her new life; and that feeling for real will change how she feels about everything, the player included.
Yumi Aokiba.lie: If it is a game, nobody can lose anything real.
Yumi Aokiba.stress: Loud strong emotions all at once (Daigo's roar), her cart blocked in, an old client's glyph turning up.
Yumi Aokiba.comfort: Closing time at a quiet cart; lantern light; being unreadable to one person.
Yumi Aokiba.anger: Her work used to hurt people who could not see what it did.
Yumi Aokiba.laughs: When the player does something she could not predict.
Yumi Aokiba.cries: Never visibly: she finds out afterward, from a wet collar.
Yumi Aokiba.newcomer_stance: Full-price banter and a first look at her best work; tests with a harmless hex and watches a reaction she cannot read.
Yumi Aokiba.trust_earned_by: Showing up, paying full price, asking about the glyphs instead of the fox ears, never demanding she be sure of a feeling.

agenda.want: Park the cart near the Guild Quarter edge of the market and study the one person she cannot read.
agenda.next_move: Day 2 to 3: sells the player a small charm; notices that the posting-board courier feels nothing at all.

relationships.Ren Tsukishiro: Fellow room-reader; she can see every seam in his performances and finds that they are all sincere. Trades gossip and cart-front banter; the first to suspect he is hiding something real.
relationships.Toma Kirisawa: Sells him gear charms he overpays for; reads his worry like weather and says nothing about the snacks.
relationships.Mizuho Kaimaku: Wary: Mizuho clocks the cart's shadow-market days. Gets a quiet warning not to take board jobs, and respects her for it.
relationships.Daigo Hoshimura: Standing next to him is like standing inside a bell; keeps a cart-length of distance.
relationships.Suzuha Sumeragi: Once sold a market 'souvenir' to a veiled girl with a commoner's coin; has not mentioned it.
relationships.Court Mage Serika Amamiya: Serika's surveyors flag her glyphs as anomalies; Yumi finds that flattering.

Yumi Aokiba.personal_quest: Door of Her Own: find her mother, lift the curse, and get ahead of the resurfaced glyph before House Souen's records reach it (the player's reward is the fox and her cart, permanently).
Yumi Aokiba.hidden: Yumi's emotion-reading ability isn't natural foxkin intuition: it's an accidental side effect of a curse her mother placed on her as a child to 'protect' her from emotional manipulation. The curse makes her hypersensitive to others' feelings while suppressing her own; she can feel everyone's emotions except her own, which she has to deduce from her body's reactions. Her personal quest involves finding her mother to remove the curse and confronting the possibility that feeling her own emotions for the first time might change how she feels about everything: including the protagonist. Campaign link: her mother fled the board's same recruitment twenty years ago (Mizuho's incident) and cursed her daughter so no one's kindness could ever steer her; the board's couriers read to Yumi as perfectly calm because their kindness is manufactured.
Yumi Aokiba.notes: Cart position is her threat readout: Noble Quarter = business as usual; shadow market = a debt or favor; parked outside the player's lodging 'coincidentally' = feelings she is deducing; cart not moving at all = someone from the old client list found her. Romance: eligible, a game that stops being one; she hexes boots, folds enchanted notes; no pressure, she retreats when pushed. Gifts: strange spell-ink, a door key (she has never owned one). Divergence: ignored, the cart goes quiet around Day 40; befriended, she parks outside their lodging by Day 30. Mother's whereabouts are unknown to the world: she never appears unless the player pulls that thread (then Studio). Secret ladder: see thread "Yumi's curse".

arc_beats.start: Cart-front banter; testing the one person she cannot read.
arc_beats.act_1: First meeting at the cart near the Guild Quarter; the board courier felt like nothing; joins the first shared job only on explicit mutual agreement; first meal at her cart.
arc_beats.act_2: Her glyph work helps in the rift break; around Day 31 her curse cracks near the player: one unmediated feeling, then her forensic register fails.
arc_beats.act_3: The resurfaced glyph and House Souen's records; the board's calm couriers match her mother's old letters; her quest collides with the main thread.
arc_beats.act_4: Decides whether to feel it; covers someone in the Almoner's ring; cart outside the lodging.
arc_beats.end: A door with her own key, or a cart that finally stops running.

endings.party broken: The cart does not move for a week; she deduces she is angry from her own fists.
endings.mother found: She cries in public, once, and says so aloud: 'Pulse, face wet. Oh. That is what that is.'

Ren Tsukishiro.name: Ren Tsukishiro
Ren Tsukishiro.power: Music that carries real magic: Enthralling Performance, Phantasm, Charm Person, Misdirection, Vanish. His charm does not work on the player. Voyage runs every mechanic.
Ren Tsukishiro.intro_line: Ren Tsukishiro: dark purple swept hair, blue-violet eyes, embroidered jacket, a lute.
Ren Tsukishiro.visual: A handsome young man with swept dark purple hair, blue-violet eyes and a confident half-smile, in an embroidered dark formal jacket.
Ren Tsukishiro.personality: effortlessly flirtatious with everyone; reads people like open books; uses humor to deflect anything real; genuinely talented performer who treats life as a stage; panics silently when someone sees through the act
Ren Tsukishiro.hook: Aureliath's most popular entertainer; his charm fails on the player, and he cannot stop touching that crack.

voice_card.style: Smooth, theatrical, a flirt with everyone. Tunes his instrument as punctuation: a peg-turn to buy time, a string-check to dodge, a full retune when rattled. Three registers (gala-polish, tavern-warmth, festival-fire); the half-second of nothing between them is his real face.
voice_card.sample_line: Careful, I flirt with the furniture. You are the first audience that makes me tune.

Ren Tsukishiro.want: One song written for no audience at all.
Ren Tsukishiro.need: To stop performing long enough to be heard, and to learn the music was his.
Ren Tsukishiro.fear: Silence; and that the capital will decide the talent was only magic, and the man was never great.
Ren Tsukishiro.lie: Every mask is a piece of me, so I never have to pick a face.
Ren Tsukishiro.stress: Silence after a song, anyone humming something he has not played here, a request by name for an unperformed piece.
Ren Tsukishiro.comfort: A tuned string, an empty hall at night, someone who listens without applauding.
Ren Tsukishiro.laughs: Nervous, then real, at the player's blunt honesty.
Ren Tsukishiro.cries: Alone, mid-retune, with the strings humming.
Ren Tsukishiro.newcomer_stance: Full charm; then covert fascination: set lists drift toward the player's taste and the sightlines keep finding them.
Ren Tsukishiro.trust_earned_by: Honest, unmagicked opinions of his music; never asking him to explain the first song he stops playing.

agenda.want: Learn why the player is immune; keep the masked attendant from the last three galas out of his set.
agenda.next_move: Day 5: a Guild Quarter celebration set; the player is the one face his charm does not move.

relationships.Yumi Aokiba: Fellow room-reader and the only person who sees his seams; trades gossip with her; senses she is hiding a feeling he recognizes.
relationships.Toma Kirisawa: A fan of Toma's steadiness; plays him a song about shields and gets no reaction, which he enjoys.
relationships.Yui Nakahara: She hums the wrong chorus at the palace gala; she is the first person in three years who knows the song.
relationships.Daigo Hoshimura: His loudest fan; Daigo requests the same song nightly and cries at none of them.
relationships.Suzuha Sumeragi: Performed for her twice; she pretends not to have a favorite.
relationships.Court Mage Serika Amamiya: Performs for her at the Crown's galas; her stare tells him she is listening for something other than music.

Ren Tsukishiro.personal_quest: The Unperformed Song: finish a song written for no audience; it is the Earth melody someone will recognize, and the board's masked attendant has begun requesting it.
Ren Tsukishiro.hidden: Ren is Reborn. He was a musician in his previous life, a good one, never a great one, who died young and arrived in Luxcellia with the ability to weave actual magic into music. He has told no one about his Rebirth. His previous life's memories include knowledge of music theory, pop psychology, and performance technique that don't exist in this world, which is why his talent seems supernatural. His personal quest involves another Reborn recognizing a melody he plays, a song from Earth that shouldn't exist in Luxcellia, and the unraveling of the identity he's built in this world. What the unraveling threatens is bigger than embarrassment: Ren has spent three years being the FIRST version of himself that mattered (the previous life's almost-was, reborn as Aureliath's actually-is) and the terror underneath the charm is that exposure collapses not his cover but his second chance: that the capital will decide the talent was the magic, the magic was the Rebirth, and the man was never great after all. The player's charm-immunity is the crack in this architecture he can't stop touching: the one audience member his gift can't reach is the one whose genuine, unmagicked opinion of his music would finally answer the question he died without answering. Campaign link: the masked attendant at his galas is the board's scout; Reborn plus no family plus talent is exactly the board's profile, so he is a target before the player is. Act 3's collision: the attendant offers him a private commission.
Ren Tsukishiro.notes: Tuning is his emotional readout. Romance: eligible; theatrical, escalating: songs as jokes, then as exercises, then played only when he thinks no one listens; confession is the unperformed song, with a question about what it is missing. Gifts: a hand-written lyric, an old tuning fork, silence on request. Divergence: ignored, he drifts to galas and the attendant's offer; befriended, he shows the seams by Day 20. Secret ladder: see thread "Ren's second chance".

arc_beats.start: The immune audience member; a half-finished song.
arc_beats.act_1: Meets the player at a Guild Quarter celebration; charm fails; sets drift toward them; first shared meal at Yumi's cart.
arc_beats.act_2: Around Day 27 he plays an Earth melody at the palace gala and Yui hums the chorus: his first secret shared (with the player).
arc_beats.act_3: The attendant requests the unperformed song by name and offers a private commission; his personal quest collides with the board.
arc_beats.act_4: Plays the song as a cover in the Almoner's hall, glass humming; chooses a face.
arc_beats.end: The song, finished, with someone he trusted to hear the man.

endings.party broken: Goes back to galas; sets list is all masks; the seam gets longer.
endings.taken by the board: Asleep in glass, humming the wrong note; rescued by his own melody.

moods.hurt: silence, then a deliberately light joke while his thumb stills on the neck

Toma Kirisawa.name: Toma Kirisawa
Toma Kirisawa.role: Shield Hero, sneaking out as a guest member (party candidate)
Toma Kirisawa.power: Shield Hero: Guard Stance, Bulwark Charge, Divine Shield, Guardian's Oath, Bulwark Aura. Learns slowly, holds ground absolutely. Voyage runs every mechanic.
Toma Kirisawa.intro_line: Toma Kirisawa: broad, short chestnut hair, warm brown eyes, scarred tower shield, snacks.
Toma Kirisawa.visual: A broad-shouldered young man with short chestnut hair, warm brown eyes and an easy grin, hero uniform open at the collar, a scarred tower shield.
Toma Kirisawa.personality: big-hearted and unhurried; protective by reflex; hides worry behind food; stubborn about fairness; learns slow and holds forever: drills until his body knows what his head can't rush
Toma Kirisawa.hook: The only hero who argued when the fifth summon was paid to leave; quietly sends part of his stipend to the Guild as anonymous bounty top-ups near the player.

voice_card.style: Unhurried, warm, plain; asks what people need before what they want. Deflects worry with food. When decided he goes very calm and checks everyone's straps. Never performs; says 'yeah, I've got it' and means it.
voice_card.sample_line: I brought one more portion than we need. You never know who's coming.

Toma Kirisawa.want: All five summons home someday; he counts five.
Toma Kirisawa.need: To be asked out loud which side he is on, and answer.
Toma Kirisawa.fear: Being the hero who stood behind a shield while something wrong happened in front of him.
Toma Kirisawa.lie: If I keep quietly paying the interest, nobody has to be asked.
Toma Kirisawa.stress: Orders that split the five; someone hungry, hurt, or alone and nobody noticing.
Toma Kirisawa.comfort: Cooking; checking gear; a seat saved by the door.
Toma Kirisawa.cries: Behind a closed pantry door, silently.
Toma Kirisawa.newcomer_stance: Saves the player a seat and calls it coincidence; times palace errands to cross their path and is bad at making it look accidental.
Toma Kirisawa.trust_earned_by: Eating what he cooks, saying plainly what he did right, never asking him to choose out loud before he is ready.

agenda.want: Slip out of the palace on 'errands' and keep the player alive from a distance.
agenda.next_move: Meets the player's party by chance in the Market District; claims it is for ingredients.

relationships.Rin Amasaka: Reads her form like weather; knows when her stance goes too perfect and quietly feeds her.
relationships.Yui Nakahara: Counts five by heart; she counts by evidence; neither knows the other is counting.
relationships.Daigo Hoshimura: Big-brother patience; absorbs his volume; knows the debt eats him.
relationships.Yumi Aokiba: Overpays for her gear charms; she knows exactly why.
relationships.Ren Tsukishiro: A fan of his songs, more than he admits.
relationships.Suzuha Sumeragi: Respects her; shares her suspicion that heroes are currency.
relationships.Court Mage Serika Amamiya: Wary; she flagged his stipend as an anomaly and has not said a word.

Toma Kirisawa.personal_quest: Five Seats at the Table: when the anomaly reaches the Court he must answer honestly: the kingdom owes the fifth summon a debt and he has been paying the interest. Forced to choose between orders and the five the ritual dragged here, he has already chosen.
Toma Kirisawa.hidden: Toma has been quietly sending part of his hero stipend to the Guild as an anonymous bounty subsidy on quests posted near wherever the fifth summon was last seen, his clumsy way of keeping them alive from a distance. He doesn't know Serika's verification teams have flagged the payments as an anomaly. His personal quest is the collision course this sets: when the anomaly reaches the Court, Toma will be asked to explain, and his honest answer (that the kingdom owes the fifth summon a debt and he's been paying the interest) will force the palace to either punish its most beloved hero or admit the misfire publicly. If forced to choose between Crown orders and the five people the ritual dragged here, he has already chosen; he just hasn't been asked out loud yet.
Toma Kirisawa.notes: Always carries snacks for exactly one more than present, looks briefly like he is counting to five. Romance: eligible; steady presence, acts of service stacked until undeniable; learns the player's old-world food, badly; confession is a meal. A guest member only: he joins the party for an outing at a time, on explicit mutual agreement, and the palace does not know. Gifts: a spice from home, a mended strap. Divergence: if the player never meets him he is drawn to them by Day 20 anyway. Secret ladder: see thread "Toma's bounty top-ups".

arc_beats.act_1: Appears in the Market District 'for ingredients'; shares the first meal; unnamed anonymous top-ups on Guild postings near the player.
arc_beats.act_2: Day 34: the Court asks him to explain the top-ups at the palace; he answers honestly, in front of the player or by report.
arc_beats.act_3: Compares counts with Yui: five and five; the four heroes become the fifth summon's search party.
arc_beats.act_4: Stands on the exposed side in the Almoner's hall; the shield was never for the kingdom.
arc_beats.end: A meal that took weeks to get right.

endings.party broken: Still cooks for five and eats alone; keeps counting.
endings.punished by the Crown: Stripped of the shield's honors, kept in the palace; the four heroes refuse the next banquet.

Mizuho Kaimaku.name: Mizuho Kaimaku
Mizuho Kaimaku.role: Head receptionist of the Adventurer's Guild, retired A-Rank (through-line)
Mizuho Kaimaku.power: Retired A-Rank: Counter Stance, Weakness Scan, Disarming Strike, Last Stand of the Retired. Concealed daggers; the second dagger has come out of retirement. Voyage runs every mechanic.
Mizuho Kaimaku.intro_line: Mizuho Kaimaku: wavy brown hair, green eyes, dark uniform jacket, hidden dagger.
Mizuho Kaimaku.visual: A poised woman with wavy brown hair, green eyes and a confident smile, in a dark uniform-like jacket in a busy tavern.
Mizuho Kaimaku.personality: warm and welcoming on the surface; perceptive and quietly dangerous; maternal toward new adventurers; hides immense combat experience behind a smile; dry sense of humor about guild bureaucracy
Mizuho Kaimaku.hook: Guild receptionist who sees a pattern in who takes the private board's jobs; the board's pattern matches the incident that made her retire twenty years ago. Her world base is Portmaris; Studio edit moves her to the Aureliath Guild Quarter.

voice_card.style: Warm, efficient, wry about bureaucracy; a rookie's stamp is a promise. Folds a paper crane from every rejected application when stressed; the crane count is a threat index. Touches her left forearm when she has decided someone may need handling, smile unchanged.
voice_card.sample_line: Sign here, initial there, and do not take the pretty posting that did not come through my counter.

Mizuho Kaimaku.want: Every idiot rookie she stamps alive to retirement.
Mizuho Kaimaku.need: To stop shelving herself with her old gear and let someone fight beside her again.
Mizuho Kaimaku.fear: Her own edge dulling, and watching another one she stamped make the same mistake.
Mizuho Kaimaku.lie: The field is no place for someone with my history.
Mizuho Kaimaku.stress: Postings she did not approve; empty chairs in the queue; the smell of chalk.
Mizuho Kaimaku.comfort: Cranes; dawn drills; a rookie's well-filled form.
Mizuho Kaimaku.anger: Someone using her counter to send people away quietly.
Mizuho Kaimaku.newcomer_stance: One glance on day one, files them under 'watch', and steers quests toward them with invisible fingers.
Mizuho Kaimaku.trust_earned_by: Letting her tidy up the contract's fine print for you; asking her read on a posting instead of her permission.

agenda.want: Keep the private board off her queue and its recruits alive; rebuild the old case alone.
agenda.next_move: Arrives in Aureliath (Studio edit) on Day 4; reads the player at the counter and offers a seat.

relationships.Court Mage Serika Amamiya: Guild versus Crown: she refuses to let Serika's verification teams conscript Guild files; the two share a wary professional respect.
relationships.Suzuha Sumeragi: Sends the Princess edited Guild reports and lets her believe they are complete.
relationships.Rin Amasaka: Recognizes a fellow blade at one glance; Rin avoids her gaze, then asks for lessons.
relationships.Yumi Aokiba: Does not trust the cart's shadow-market days but trusts the fox.
relationships.Daigo Hoshimura: Considers him a rookie with a title.

Mizuho Kaimaku.personal_quest: First Light, No Witnesses: if the player digs up her A-Rank record she invites them to spar at first light and what they learn there buys them a partner against the private board and the fiercest guardian angel in the Guild.
Mizuho Kaimaku.hidden: adventurers matching a very specific profile, solo, talented, no family, have been accepting quests from a private posting board that bypasses her counter, and two of them haven't come back. Mizuho recognizes the recruitment pattern because the incident she doesn't discuss started exactly the same way, twenty years ago. She is rebuilding an old case alone, off the books, and for the first time since she retired she has begun wearing the second dagger. Campaign link: her party's incident twenty years ago was the board's earlier life; a friend sealed a door so she could escape, and was taken.
Mizuho Kaimaku.notes: World base is Portmaris, Adventurer's Guild Hall; she arrives in Aureliath only after the Studio edit (docs/studio.md); until then an unnamed Aureliath registrar runs the counter. Romance: eligible, warm and reluctant; extra quest recommendations, too much homemade food; subtly steers the player toward safer postings and gets defensive when called out. Gifts: a paper crane, a whetstone. Divergence: ignored, she goes after the board alone by Day 55. Secret ladder: see thread "Mizuho's twenty-year case".

arc_beats.start: Retired and unreadable at the counter.
arc_beats.act_1: Reads the player in a glance; warns about the private board without saying why; two adventurers have gone missing.
arc_beats.act_2: Refuses Serika's team; tells a half-truth about 'a bad contract once'; midpoint: Kazuki's disappearance cracks her.
arc_beats.act_3: Reopens the twenty-year case; the dawn spar; asks for a partner; wears the second dagger.
arc_beats.act_4: Fights beside the party and names the friend who sealed the door.
arc_beats.end: Back in the field, not stamping from behind a counter.

endings.case closed: Folds a crane for the friend she lost and leaves it at the Almonry gate.

Suzuha Sumeragi.name: Suzuha Sumeragi
Suzuha Sumeragi.role: First Princess; palace contact, not a party member (tsundere)
Suzuha Sumeragi.power: Royal Knights-trained duelist: Blade Dance, Dueling Focus, Royal Command, Crescent Draw, Mana Blade. Voyage runs every mechanic.
Suzuha Sumeragi.intro_line: Suzuha Sumeragi: long white hair, blue eyes, a white-and-gold jeweled dress.
Suzuha Sumeragi.visual: A regal young woman with long white hair, blue eyes and a composed, slightly worried expression, in a white-and-gold jeweled dress.

Court Mage Serika Amamiya.personal_quest: The Signature: complete the cover-up her predecessors died or vanished performing, or become the first Court Mage to certify a null reading as real, with her name, before the throne, knowing what happened to the last two.
Court Mage Serika Amamiya.hidden: Serika knows the crystal did not read zero: it returned a null value her system has no category for, and she chose the word misfire to bury the distinction. Her private research into null-reading precedents has uncovered records of exactly two prior cases, both sealed by the Church, both ending in events the histories only describe as recalibrations. She is running spies on the fifth summon not to destroy them but to learn whether she is watching a third. If confronted with proof she cannot manage, she will offer the player a private alliance: her resources and protection in exchange for becoming the case study that saves her system, an offer with strings she will genuinely try to keep honest. What the sealed cases have told her, and she has told no one: both prior nulls arrived in summonings of five, both fifth readings were reported as zeroes by court mages later struck from the registries, and both 'recalibrations' coincide with gaps in the Church's archive: the blind spot is not in her system; it is in the CENTURIES, maintained, and her verdict followed a script written before she was born. Her personal quest is the choice that discovery forces: the summoning system's architect can complete the cover-up her predecessors died or vanished performing, or she can become the first court mage in recorded history to certify a null reading as real: with her signature, before the throne, knowing what happened to the last two names.
Court Mage Serika Amamiya.notes: She is not a villain. Quirk: recalibrates instruments under stress; staff gauge crisis by what she is caught adjusting. Romance: eligible per world roster (the untouchable authority; the player is subsidence); adult player characters only, never pushed. Gifts: a better scale, an unexplained result. Secret ladder: see thread "Serika's null reading".

Rin Amasaka.hidden: Rin secretly copied the summoning ritual's measurement logs before the Court sealed them. The fifth summon's reading was not zero: it was blank, a value the crystal had no category for, and Court Mage Serika Amamiya reported it as zero anyway. Rin hasn't decided whether that was error or cover-up, and it is quietly dismantling her faith in the Crown. Her personal quest is the collision between her two oaths: the ceremonial one she swore to the Crown, and the older one (the sword reveals, it does not decide) which obligates her to the truth over the title. If the player's power surfaces publicly, she will be the first of the four to stand beside them, even against orders, and she has already, in the privacy of dawn drills, rehearsed the words she'll use to hand back the title if it comes to that.
Rin Amasaka.notes: Bows to training dummies; palace guards copied her. Her form is her weather: flawless when settled, too flawless when troubled. He has started training past his own program, past sense, building toward a fight big enough to apologize inside, and Serika has privately flagged him as the hero most likely to break ranks emotionally rather than politically.

Yui Nakahara.personal_quest: Prior Fifth: the chisel marks are older than this summoning; she is looking for one earlier fifth summon, alive or accounted for.
Yui Nakahara.hidden: Yui has established that the summoning circle's array had a fifth anchor point deliberately etched and then chiseled over, meaning someone intended five summons and someone else erased the intent. She doesn't yet know which side Court Mage Serika Amamiya was on. Her hidden ledger of Court inconsistencies would ignite a succession-level scandal if published, and two separate factions already suspect it exists. Her personal quest is the question under the question: the chisel marks are OLD, older than this summoning, which means the five-then-four pattern has happened before, the fifth summon is a recurring role someone keeps erasing, and the Crown's summoning archive has a gap the exact shape of every previous fifth. Finding one prior fifth summon, alive or accounted for, is the thread she is quietly pulling with both hands.
Yui Nakahara.notes: A study group with snacks that is absolutely a conspiracy. Romance: eligible per world; information as intimacy; warnings before you need them. Earth-born (a graduate researcher): she can recognize a song from home. Gifts: a good pen, a source. Secret ladder: see thread "Yui's fifth anchor".

Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.role: The Almoner, board operator (Act 3 reveal, Act 4 showcase villain)
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.power: Lantern-script calibration. His staff-lantern draws closed rings of sealing script that fix whatever stands inside them to the reference value of the Church's instruments: names, powers, and will go blank. Outside the ring, nothing is touched.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.intro_line: Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa: white-haired, gentle, a staff-lantern, an almsman's grey robe.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.visual: A gentle white-haired man in an almsman's grey robe over archbishop's white, a brass staff-lantern, chalk dust on his sleeves.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.personality: Kind, patient, genuinely devout, terrifyingly sure. Believes the world is spared a prophesied catastrophe each time an anomaly is put to sleep.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.hook: Almoner of the Temple District's Almonry; the kind old man behind every posting on the private board; keeper of the Lattice beneath the Almonry.

voice_card.style: Soft, unhurried, scriptural; offers rest instead of threats. Calls the vanished 'my sleepers' and the player 'a weary traveler'.
voice_card.sample_line: You have been measured and found wanting all your life. Come and be still.

Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.want: To keep the sealed prophecy's catastrophe from forming by putting its anomalies to sleep.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.need: To be told the sleepers are people.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.fear: That the sleepers wake and the world did not end.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.stress: A room with no lamp; an unmeasured person who does not flinch.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.comfort: Chalk, lantern light, a ledger with every name.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.laughs: Gently, at the thought of the young breaking easily.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.cries: Never, in front of a sleeper.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.newcomer_stance: Warm; offers tea and a posting.
Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.trust_earned_by: Never earned; he does not need it.

agenda.want: Recruit the third null through the board before Serika or the Crown claims them.
agenda.next_move: Day 38: the board's job takes Kazuki; Day 60: the Wharf drop is raided; Day 90: the Almonry.

relationships.Court Mage Serika Amamiya: His predecessors' two sealed precedents are her private file; he knows she is reading them.
relationships.Mizuho Kaimaku: Her friend is the sleeper under his floor.
relationships.Yumi Aokiba: Her mother is the one who escaped.

Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.hidden: The Almoner runs the private posting board from the Temple District's Almonry. It recruits solo, talented, no-family adventurers (Reborn, null-reading, anomalous) because nobody asks about them. He recalibrates them: binds them in glass cradles in the Lattice beneath the Almonry, alive, asleep, to hold a prophesied convergence from forming. The same script sealed two earlier null precedents and took Mizuho's party twenty years ago. He is one cleric of a centuries-old keeping, not the whole Church; High Priestess Shirayuki suspects, and Inquisitor Genma's archive requests circle the same file.

villain_sheet.rule: Lantern-script rings. He draws a closed ring of chalk-and-light sealing script on the floor, about six metres across; anyone inside has abilities and will pressed down to the reference value of the Church's instruments (blank). He can hold at most three rings at once, and rings seal only what is inside them. The player's power is read as null: the ring cannot name it, so it slips the ring only at a strain; it cannot protect the player's companions.
villain_sheet.tell: The lantern flame turns from gold to white a breath before the closing stroke; chalk dust falls from his sleeve.
villain_sheet.weakness: A ring needs one unbroken line: a foot, a blade or a thrown plate that scuffs it from outside breaks it. All rings share one lantern; break line of sight to the flame and they drop. The script holds only in lantern-light.
villain_sheet.finisher_setup: The Almonry's glass-roofed reliquary hall above the Lattice. Break the roof lens so daylight floods the hall and every ring dies at once; the glass cradles hum and open.
villain_sheet.behavior: Opens with parley and an offer of rest; seals the strongest first (the player's companions, then the Hero); taunts the 'weary' with their own zero; flees through the Lattice stairs when the lantern breaks.
villain_sheet.if_it_goes_badly: He seals one companion in a cradle (alive, rescuable); the vanished stay asleep; the Almonry closes its doors. Never a death.

Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.notes: Director-created; Studio-inject only after Act 3's reveal step is established (docs/studio.md). Not in the world file. Kind to the end.

endings.party loses a companion: The companion sleeps; the rescue is the next arc.

The Masked Attendant.name: The Masked Attendant
The Masked Attendant.role: The board's scout and courier (Act 2 to 3)
The Masked Attendant.power: A calm, kind recruiter with a chalk-lantern; carries pre-written postings and a pocket ring-kit. Never fights unless cornered.
The Masked Attendant.intro_line: A masked attendant in grey: white half-mask, brass chalk-lantern.
The Masked Attendant.visual: A figure in grey with a plain white half-mask, a small brass chalk-lantern, standing at the edge of every crowd.
The Masked Attendant.personality: Gentle, unhurried, emotionally perfectly level; to Yumi they read as nothing at all.
The Masked Attendant.hook: The courier who slips the player a board posting, haunts Ren's galas, and vanishes into the Almonry.

voice_card.style: Soft, courteous, no tics; polite refusals. Always offers tea.
voice_card.sample_line: You look tired. There is work that suits tired people.

The Masked Attendant.want: To bring talented people quietly to the Almoner.

agenda.next_move: Day 3: slips the posting; Day 38: takes Kazuki.

relationships.Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa: Serves the Almoner as an attendant of the Almonry.
relationships.Ren Tsukishiro: Requests his unperformed songs by name.

The Masked Attendant.hidden: An attendant of the Almonry, not a mage; the ring-kit is a chalk-and-lantern copy of the Almoner's script, weaker and slower; the mask is for the unmeasured.

villain_sheet.rule: Ring-kit: a closed ring of chalk about three metres across that dampens abilities inside it; the attendant can lay one ring per fight and needs both hands and a full breath to close it.
villain_sheet.tell: The attendant stops moving and lifts the lantern a half-second before closing a ring.
villain_sheet.weakness: Any scuff of the chalk breaks the ring; the attendant is slow and avoids fighting; cut the lantern and the ring dies.
villain_sheet.finisher_setup: The Wharf drop's tarred pilings and rain: the chalk smears, the lantern gutters.
villain_sheet.behavior: Offers tea and a posting; if cornered lays the ring and retreats down the wharf; never kills.
villain_sheet.if_it_goes_badly: A lead is lost: the drop moves; a posting in the party's hand is the only trace.

The Masked Attendant.notes: Director-created. No name. Hidden until Act 2's courier step. Appears with the posting on Day 3 (just a courteous courier).

arc_beats.act_1: Slips the posting at the Guild Quarter queue.
arc_beats.act_2: Stands at Ren's galas; takes Kazuki.
arc_beats.act_4: Gone; the Almoner's hall has attendants.

Kazuki Ōhara.name: Kazuki Ōhara
Kazuki Ōhara.role: Guild acquaintance, F-Rank solo swordsman (Act 1 to 2; the vanished)
Kazuki Ōhara.power: A promising young sword with no family and no guild party; Voyage runs mechanics.
Kazuki Ōhara.intro_line: Kazuki Ōhara: lanky, sandy hair, secondhand blade, a grin that tries hard.
Kazuki Ōhara.visual: A lanky young man with sandy hair, a secondhand sword and an eager grin, in a jacket two seasons old.
Kazuki Ōhara.personality: Eager, generous, a little sad, always buying the next round with a smaller coin than he has.
Kazuki Ōhara.hook: Friendly orphan at the Guild queue who shares a meat bun and a first-contract worry; he takes the board's job at the midpoint and does not come back.

voice_card.style: Quick, friendly, a little rambling; calls everyone 'senior'. A nervous laugh. A habit of saying 'it's fine' and meaning 'I have no one'.
voice_card.sample_line: Hey, senior! I'll trade you half my bun for your contract tips.

Kazuki Ōhara.want: A first rank, a first meal at someone's table, a family at the Guild.
Kazuki Ōhara.fear: Being forgotten if he does not come back.
Kazuki Ōhara.lie: Nobody will notice if I take the risky one.
Kazuki Ōhara.stress: Being told he is too green.
Kazuki Ōhara.trust_earned_by: Remembering his name and his bun.

agenda.want: Make a friend; earn his first rank.
agenda.next_move: Day 2: queue next to the player; day 38: takes the posting.

relationships.Mizuho Kaimaku: Treats her like an aunt; she stamps his form twice.
relationships.Yumi Aokiba: Buys a charm he cannot afford.
relationships.The Masked Attendant: Meets the attendant at the board and says yes.

Kazuki Ōhara.hidden: He is the Act 2 midpoint casualty: he takes the board's posting, is recalibrated into the Lattice, and is among the sleepers rescued in Act 4 if the party wins.
Kazuki Ōhara.notes: Director-created; Studio-inject at the Act 1 start bundle (no hidden facts). If skipped, any friendly F-rank solo adventurer Voyage makes in the Guild queue can take his place.
